question: What result follows from reciting this hymn with devotion to Gaṇeśa?
premises: One should recite this hymn with devotion.
The hymn is addressed in the context of Gaṇeśa.
The king of the gaṇas becomes pleased.
inference: Devotional recitation of this hymn brings the pleasure of Gaṇeśa.
plain_english: One should recite this hymn with devotion; then the king of the gaṇas is pleased.
